project.name: automated-pull-reviewer
project.objective: Automated PR reviewer: a tool that automatically reviews pull requests for code quality, security, and style issues, and posts feedback

approval.reason: Approved MVP core-loop scope with Tiger Cloud data store, as discussed 2026-09-09

assumptions.text: No default confidence threshold value is specified for the HITL gate's auto-post vs human-queue decision; this must be set explicitly during planning/implementation and is tracked as an open question in SPEC.md.

Prompt-injection mitigation for attacker-controlled PR diff content reaching specialist prompts (esp. the security specialist) is unresolved; no auto-post path should be trusted in production until this is addressed.

decisions.title: Multi-agent specialist architecture
decisions.text: Use four parallel specialist agents (security, quality, tests, docs) fanned out via LangGraph instead of one generalist prompt, each grounded via hybrid RAG retrieval before reasoning, merged by an aggregator into structured Findings.

decisions.title: LangGraph over Temporal (ADR-001)
decisions.text: Chosen for zero extra infrastructure, first-class parallel fan-out (Send API), and Redis-based checkpointing reusing the existing queue. Kept behind a narrow interface (core/workflow_engine.py) so it is swappable for Temporal if scale demands it later.

decisions.title: Modular monolith, not microservices (ADR-002)
decisions.text: One deployed process with 23 inward-only-dependency modules. Deferred splitting into a stateless ingress service + separate worker pool until a measured bottleneck (single ARQ worker) actually occurs.

decisions.title: Tiger Cloud as single data spine (ADR-003)
decisions.text: One Postgres-compatible store (Tiger Cloud: Postgres + TimescaleDB + pgvector/pgvectorscale) carries vector memory, relational truth, and time-series events, instead of three separate specialized databases. Redis stays separate for ephemeral queue/checkpoint state only. Confirmed as a hard requirement by the user for v1, not deferred to a simpler local Postgres.

decisions.title: BudgetGuard hard cost cap (ADR-004)
decisions.text: BudgetGuard reads a live continuous-aggregate cost rollup and hard-blocks new LLM calls once a daily spend cap is exceeded, checked before each call rather than reconciled after.

decisions.title: V1 scope: MVP core loop only
decisions.text: Implementation for v1 covers roughly phases 0-8 of the source roadmap: webhook ingress+idempotency, queue, LangGraph fan-out to 4 specialists with RAG grounding, aggregator, confidence-weighted HITL gate, post back to GitHub. Full observability dashboard, evaluation harness, governance, economics dashboard, CI/CD-for-AI, and continuous learning are explicitly deferred as later tasks, not part of this specification.
